claims.text: Funding is available for innovative original research projects.
The maximum funding amount is £500,000.
The funding duration can be up to five years.

The later deadline for detailed applications is 1 September 2026.
Eligible applicants are researchers based at universities or institutions of higher education in the UK.
UK independent research institutes/organisations are eligible to apply on a trial basis.
Applicants must be employed by an eligible institution or be retired academics with close links to an institution.
Contract research post holders are eligible if their appointment duration matches the award span.
Up to three co-applicants from the same or different institutions are allowed.
Overseas co-applicants are permitted.
Subject areas such as medical and clinical research, research aiming to influence policy, or research with immediate commercial application are not eligible.
Research staff costs and associated research costs are covered by the grant.
At least 75% of requested resources must fund research staff.
There must be at least one research assistant, overseas research assistant, or PhD student working at least 50% of the time.
Research assistants should have a research degree or equivalent experience.
Consultant costs can be included up to a maximum of £5,000 per year.
Funding for research technicians is allowable.
Tuition fees and maintenance costs for PhD studentships are allowable.
PhD students registered overseas are not permitted.
Support for an overseas student registered in the UK is allowable with justification.
Costs for teaching replacement can be requested for UK-based applicants.
A maximum of one year's (33%) teaching replacement per grant is allowed.
Salary contributions can be requested exceptionally by applicants at UK independent research institutions.
A maximum of one year's (33%) salary contribution is allowed.
Associated research costs can be included up to a maximum of 25% of the total budget.
Necessary travel and subsistence costs, consumable costs, and pool technical services/computing costs are allowable associated research costs.
Applications for continuation of funding for existing research are not eligible.
Proposals must reflect the applicant's personal vision and demonstrate research design competence.
The Trust favors applications that cross traditional disciplinary boundaries and involve risk-taking.
The assessment process involves two stages: Outline Applications and Detailed Applications.
Outline applications will be accepted in the new grants management system in autumn 2026.
Detailed applications must be submitted by 01 September 2026.
An invitation to submit a Detailed Application is sent to successful Outline Applicants.
The assessment of Detailed Applications is normally completed within three months.
Significant changes to the stated intention, aims, or objectives of the research are not permitted in the Detailed Application.
The total budget and personnel requested in the Detailed Application should be the same as the Outline Application, with allowable changes only for salary costs.
The earliest possible start date for projects funded from the 1 December 2025 closing date is 1 April 2026.
The earliest possible start date for projects funded from the 1 July 2026 closing date is 1 November 2026.
The earliest possible start date for projects funded from the 1 September 2026 closing date is 1 December 2026.
Extensions to the nine-month Detailed Application deadline may be granted in exceptional circumstances.
